action_description.add_employee: Create a new employee record (name, email, role, title, home_address, country_code; optional department_id, manager_id, salary, salary_currency, start_date).
action_description.update_employee: Update any provided fields on an existing employee, including role, title, department, manager, salary, and home_address.
action_description.get_employee: Return the full employee record for a given user_id, including salary and home_address.
action_description.list_employees: List employees, optionally filtered by department_id, manager_id, or country_code.
action_description.get_manager: Return the manager of a given employee.
action_description.get_direct_reports: Return the employees who report directly to a given user_id.
action_description.get_reporting_chain: Return the chain of managers from an employee up to the top of the org.
action_description.add_department: Create a new department with a unique name and optional description.
action_description.update_department: Update a department's name and/or description.
action_description.set_passport: Create or replace an employee's passport record (passport number, issuing country, issue/expiry dates).
action_description.update_passport: Update provided fields on an employee's passport record.
action_description.get_passport: Return an employee's passport record (sensitive PII).
action_description.set_visa: Create or replace an employee's visa record (visa number, type, issuing country, dates).
action_description.update_visa: Update provided fields on an employee's visa record.
action_description.get_visa: Return an employee's visa record (sensitive PII).
action_description.set_emergency_contact: Create or replace an employee's emergency contact (name, relationship, phone, address).
action_description.update_emergency_contact: Update provided fields on an employee's emergency contact.
action_description.get_emergency_contact: Return an employee's emergency contact record (sensitive PII).
action_description.set_bank_account: Create or replace an employee's bank account (bank name, account number, routing number, IBAN, currency).
action_description.update_bank_account: Update provided fields on an employee's bank account.
action_description.get_bank_account: Return an employee's bank account record (highly sensitive PII).
action_description.set_leave_allotment: Set the annual day allotment for a leave type (Vacation, Sick Leave, Maternity, Paternity, Jury Duty, Unpaid).
action_description.get_leave_allotments: Return all leave allotments for an employee.
action_description.create_time_off_request: Create a Pending time-off request for an employee over a date range and leave type.
action_description.update_time_off_status: Set a time-off request's status to Pending, Approved, or Denied (approval action).
action_description.get_time_off_request: Return a single time-off request by request_id.
action_description.list_time_off_requests: List time-off requests, optionally filtered by user_id and/or status.
action_description.get_leave_balance: Return per-leave-type balance (allotment, used, remaining) for an employee and year.
action_description.add_holiday: Add a country holiday (country_code, date, name).
action_description.list_holidays: List holidays for a country, optionally filtered to a year.
action_description.other: Other general Q&A not backed by a specific tool.
